title: Marketing Sync — Q3 Launch
description: Q3 launch campaign planning: channels, budget, and timeline.
transcript: 00:04 Vishesh Gupta: Hey both, thanks for joining. Today is all about the Q3 launch — the October 28th launch date is locked, so we need to finalize channels, budget, and the timeline today.
00:21 Neha Kulkarni: The campaign concept is finalized on my side — the whole angle is stop taking notes, start taking action. I think it's our strongest hook yet.
00:34 Aditya Joshi: I agree, it tested really well. In the message tests, it beat our previous positioning by 28% on both recall and click-through.
00:46 Vishesh Gupta: That's great news. What's the media plan looking like, Neha?
00:51 Neha Kulkarni: Core channels are LinkedIn, YouTube pre-roll, and the newsletter. We'll add paid search in week three once we know which landing pages convert.
01:04 Aditya Joshi: What's the split on the budget?
01:08 Neha Kulkarni: Total budget is $12,000 — roughly $5,000 on LinkedIn, $4,000 on YouTube, $2,000 on paid search, and $1,000 for creative production.
01:22 Vishesh Gupta: Does that include the launch event?
01:26 Neha Kulkarni: The virtual launch event is separate — that's the $3,000 line item in the brand budget, not the campaign budget.
01:36 Aditya Joshi: I'm a little worried about LinkedIn only getting $5,000. Our last two launches, LinkedIn drove 60% of demo signups.
01:47 Neha Kulkarni: That's fair. What if we shift $500 from paid search into LinkedIn in week two if the CPL is under $40?
01:57 Aditya Joshi: That works for me. A conditional shift keeps us honest.
02:02 Vishesh Gupta: Let's make that a decision — conditional $500 shift in week two if CPL is under $40. Neha, can you own that?
02:13 Neha Kulkarni: Yes, I'll set the trigger in the dashboard and report on it in our weekly sync.
02:20 Vishesh Gupta: Aditya, how's the content engine coming?
02:25 Aditya Joshi: Good — we have the launch post, a customer story with Maya's team, and the product demo video. The demo video is 90 seconds, and we'll cut it into six shorts.
02:39 Vishesh Gupta: Six shorts from one video? Ambitious. When do they ship?
02:44 Aditya Joshi: The first two ship on launch day, then two per week for the following two weeks.
02:52 Neha Kulkarni: I'd love to coordinate the shorts with the newsletter sends. If we can pair each short with a send, we get twice the mileage.
03:01 Aditya Joshi: Works for me. I'll share the shorts calendar by Wednesday and you can map the sends against it.
03:09 Vishesh Gupta: What about the landing page? Is it on track?
03:14 Neha Kulkarni: The copy is final, and the dev build goes live in staging on October 20th. We have a week of QA buffer before launch day.
03:26 Vishesh Gupta: And the customer story — do we have approval from Maya's team?
03:32 Aditya Joshi: I spoke to Maya yesterday. They're happy to be featured, but legal wants to review the final cut before we publish anything.
03:42 Vishesh Gupta: Okay, let's get legal the draft early. Aditya, when can you send it?
03:47 Aditya Joshi: I'll send the draft to Maya's legal by Friday, which gives them a full week before our publish date of October 24th.
03:58 Vishesh Gupta: Good. One thing I want on the record — the success metric. What are we measuring this launch on?
04:06 Neha Kulkarni: The north star is 500 demo signups in the first two weeks, with a stretch goal of 800.
04:15 Aditya Joshi: And we'll track CPL weekly — if it holds under $40, we're healthy.
04:22 Vishesh Gupta: 500 signups in two weeks, CPL under $40. Clear. What are the risks? Anything keeping you both up at night?
04:31 Neha Kulkarni: Honestly, the timeline is tight. If the landing page slips past the 20th, we lose the QA buffer, and that's when launches get messy.
04:42 Aditya Joshi: My risk is the customer story — if legal wants changes, the publish date moves, and the story anchors our week two content.
04:52 Vishesh Gupta: Okay, so let's mitigate both. Neha, lock the landing page scope today — no new asks. Aditya, get the draft to legal early and front-load that review.
05:06 Neha Kulkarni: Agreed, I'll lock the scope with the web team this afternoon.
05:12 Aditya Joshi: And I'll get the legal draft out by Friday, plus a backup plan — if the story slips, we promote the demo video harder in week two.
05:24 Vishesh Gupta: Perfect. Let's recap owners and dates, then we're done.
05:29 Neha Kulkarni: Landing page scope locked today, live in staging October 20th. Conditional $500 budget shift decision in week two. Weekly CPL reporting in our sync.
05:44 Aditya Joshi: Shorts calendar by Wednesday, legal draft by Friday, customer story publishes October 24th if approved.
05:55 Vishesh Gupta: And I'll present the full launch plan at the leadership review on October 21st. Thanks both — this was a really productive sync. Talk next week!
06:12 Neha Kulkarni: Thanks, bye!

summary.overview: Q3 launch sync for the October 28th launch. Campaign concept is locked ("stop taking notes, start taking action" — beat previous positioning by 28% in tests). Media plan: LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletter + week-three paid search on a $12,000 campaign budget (plus a separate $3,000 event line). Decision made: conditional $500 shift from search to LinkedIn in week two if CPL < $40. Success metric: 500 demo signups in two weeks (stretch 800). Risks: landing-page timeline (staging Oct 20, no slippage) and legal review of the customer story.
